identity.article_type.decision: Official article-type page identifies Article; identity is a mandatory package selector.

title.max_words.decision: Only remains evaluable where the rule is VERIFIED; UNKNOWN rules stay manual through rule status.

abstract.max_words.decision: Explicit hard maximum with canonical abstract scope.

main_text.max_words.decision: Explicit source exclusions; PARTIAL Nature Communications rule remains non-evaluable by override below.

references.max_count.decision: Official pages describe the count as a guideline, not a hard maximum.

display_items.max_count.decision: Hard maximum where VERIFIED; qualified Nature Communications rule is disabled below.

sections.required.decision: Required structure is official, but unheaded Introduction and conditional sections make current deterministic selector incomplete.

cover_letter.required.decision: Required submission component, evaluated only when canonical submission metadata is present.

supplement.allowed.decision: Optional permission is not an existence requirement; current EXISTS representation is not executable.

extended_data.max_count.decision: Official maximum applies only when Extended Data are used; canonical model lacks a distinct deterministic collection.

figures.separate_files.decision: Current evidence and initial-submission alternatives do not establish unconditional applicability.

statements.code_availability.required.decision: Current profile evidence does not establish a complete journal/article applicability condition.

statements.ethics_consent.required.decision: Current profile evidence does not establish applicability; not promoted to CONDITIONAL without evidence.

main_text.max_words.decision: Official wording is ideal rather than mandatory; scope is explicit but rule remains PARTIAL.

display_items.max_count.decision: Maximum depends on word count and the current rule does not encode the conditional tiers.

sections.required.decision: Discussion and Methods are explicitly qualified as if appropriate.
